pages.text: The Life Breeder is where you $(4)roll traits$(0) onto an organ.$(br2)$(bold)Requirements:$(0) the organ must be $(bold)non-native and set$(0), with room left below the trait cap.$(br2)$(bold)Cost:$(0) 1 same-source gene sequence, 2 Exhausted Crystals and 60,000 life energy, over 1,000 ticks (50 seconds).$(br2)$(bold)Success rate:$(0) scales linearly with sequence purity — about 35% at purity 25, up to 70% at purity 100.$(br2)Success duplicates the organ and attaches 1 random trait; failure keeps the organ, but $(4)materials are still consumed$(0).

$(bold)Traits come in tiers 1-3$(0); which tiers can roll is set by the breeding sequence's purity:$(li)purity <60: tier 1 only$(li)60-84: tiers 1-2$(li)≥85: every tier unlocked$(br2)Each roll is roughly $(4)70% benign / 30% aberrant$(0) — seven in ten are pure gains, three in ten come with a price tag (see "$(l:akaishi:trait_dual)Aberrant Traits$(/l)").$(br2)After high-tier traits? Secure a steady supply of high-purity sequences — that's exactly what the Cultivator is for.

$(bold)【Tier 1 · Safe traits】$(0)$(br2)$(li)Dense Tissue (dense_tissue): +1 armor$(li)Muscle Fiber (muscle_fiber): +1 attack damage$(li)Hyperactive Marrow (marrow_hyper): +3 max health$(li)Reflex Neurons (reflex_neuron): +0.4 attack speed$(li)Elastic Tendon (elastic_tendon): +1.5% move speed$(br2)All tier 1 traits are clean, purely positive little boosts — stable, no side effects, a great baseline.

$(bold)【Tier 2 · Safe traits】$(0)$(br2)$(li)Night-Vision Retina (night_retina): permanent night vision$(li)Gill Slits (gill_slit): water breathing$(li)Bioluminescent Cells (glow_cells): self-glow$(li)Carapace Growth (carapace_growth): +2 armor, +0.2 knockback resistance$(li)Venom Gland (venom_gland): attacks inflict poison$(br2)From tier 2 onward $(4)passive traits$(0) appear — traits are no longer just stat sticks.

$(bold)【Tier 3 · Safe traits】$(0)$(br2)$(li)Crystal Carapace (crystal_carapace): +1.5 armor, reflects melee damage$(li)Shadow Vein (shadow_vein): chance to blink-dodge when hit$(li)Stem Cell Regeneration (stem_regen): continuous regeneration$(li)Jump Tendons (jump_tendons): jump boost$(br2)Tier 3 is the ceiling for safe traits — any stronger positive usually comes with the price of an "$(l:akaishi:trait_dual)aberration$(/l)".
Suggested order: browse this page and "Aberrant Traits" for the trait catalogs; "Trait Reforger" fixes bad rolls; traits live on organs — see "Organ Construction" for where organs come from.
